classification.difficultyReason: Determine the overlapping interval and check which source interval excludes each endpoint before sketching.

content.prompt:
Sketch the following on a number line.
$(-3,5]\cap[-4,1)$

answer.worked:
Both conditions hold precisely when $-3<x<1$.
$$(-3,5]\cap[-4,1)=(-3,1).$$
Both endpoints are open.
